description: This file implements a Timer plugin for the WPEFramework, providing timer management functionalities such as start, cancel, suspend, resume, and status reporting. It handles timer events, communicates with external systems via IARM, and exposes methods for external control.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: Main class implementing timer management, event handling, and RPC method registration.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, sets up IARM communication.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources and deinitializes IARM communication.

methods.name: checkTimers
methods.description: Checks and updates the status of all timers, schedules next timeout.

methods.name: startTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer with a given ID.

methods.name: cancelTimer
methods.description: Cancels a timer with a given ID.

methods.name: onTimerCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when the timer fires, processes expired timers.

methods.name: getTimerStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current status of a specified timer.

methods.name: startTimerWrapper
methods.description: RPC wrapper to start a timer based on JSON parameters.

methods.name: cancelWrapper
methods.description: RPC wrapper to cancel a timer.

methods.name: suspendWrapper
methods.description: RPC wrapper to suspend a timer.

methods.name: resumeWrapper
methods.description: RPC wrapper to resume a suspended timer.

methods.name: getTimerStatusWrapper
methods.description: RPC wrapper to get timer status.

methods.name: getTimersWrapper
methods.description: RPC wrapper to list all timers.

methods.name: sendTimerExpired
methods.description: Sends notification and external signals when a timer expires.

methods.name: sendTimerExpiryReminder
methods.description: Sends reminder notification before timer expiry.
